ivy: quick note — brought up Avalanche LoRA merge for cust-aurora on int4. quick-smoke shows repeated opening token and short answers on a couple instruct prompts. not widespread but customer saw one.
matt: can you paste sample ids?
ivy: sample 3 and 17. sample 3 repeats first token twice.
gloria: which tokenizer? cust-aurora uses a small vocab patch. remap order?
ivy: we ran merge then remap (post-merge). run: `./eval/quick.sh --model avalanche-aurora-lora:int4 --promptset cust-aurora-30 --batch 4 --seed 5`
eval-bot: Eval-bot: job 1725300100 started (avalanche-aurora-lora:int4)
matt: try batch=1 + --kv-check and an int8 baseline to isolate quant. also run remap-before-merge A/B.
infra: pinging @infra for kernel-path differences int4 vs int8 on that job id.
ivy: kicked A/B and int8 baseline. will post artifacts. added samples 3/17 to promptset "cust-aurora-smoke" for Optimize alerts.
gloria: if remap-first fixes it, update merge-tool default for cust-aurora. if not, pin to int8 until we investigate. :thumbsup:
